name: 2one
source: Generated from the canonical tokens. Do not edit by hand — run `npm run tokens`.
theme: light — Canva designs sit on light grounds. The dark palette is in the token JSON under semantic_dark.

fonts.heading: Satoshi
fonts.note: The heading font ships as .woff2 in this repo. Canva brand-font upload may not accept .woff2; convert to .otf/.ttf if it refuses.

logo.rules: Never recolour, rotate, distort, or add effects. Never typeset the name as text in place of the mark.

rules: Grayscale only — never introduce a brand hue.
danger/success are for validation state only, never decoration.
Never convey state by colour alone — pair with an icon or text.
Any colour-token change must pass `npm run a11y`.
